name: Astolfo Ezreal Deluxe

description:
### ✨ Overview

Average polish male, now in League of Legends.
This mod puts Astolfo in a school outfit over Ezreal. Truly a femboy deluxe

#

### ✨ Additional information

The mod replaces the Base Ezreal skin.

❗This skin is a [variant](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Category:Skin_variants "skin variant - what is that?") of another custom skin: [Astolfo Ezreal](https://divineskins.gg/Wiko/astolfo-ezreal "astolfo ezreal but not as much of a femboy")

#

### ✨ Features

* New model and textures
* Modified loadingscreen
* Modified in-game icons

#

Credits to [drosari](https://sketchfab.com/drosari "guy who made the astolfo sword model") for the [sword model](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/astolfos-sword-3f5ad88ba4eb4accbfb78ada7d16abe1 "astolfo sword model link").
